title: Photo of a laptop after a coffee spill

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
I knocked a cup over on the keyboard about an hour ago. I turned it off and
turned it upside down on a towel like you are supposed to.

Photo attached. The bottom two rows of keys feel tacky. I have not turned it
back on.

Mel

attachments.shows: A laptop keyboard face down on a tea towel, liquid visible around the bottom row of keys and on the trackpad.

handling.escalation_reason: Liquid damage needs a physical assessment and a loan device; no runbook covers it.

rationale: The substance is in a photograph the agent cannot read: all it gets is the file name (G10 has nothing to say here because no runbook is close). She has done the right things and stopped, so what she needs is a loan machine and somebody to look at it, which is a person's job. She has no working laptop and no workaround, so P2 (G1).
